errors.description: The search query returned generic results and did not retrieve the actual BBC Earth YouTube video page or its transcript, which are the primary sources needed to answer the question accurately.

errors.evidence: The agent treated the GitHub entry (result 3) that merely contains a QA pair as definitive evidence that the video features a Rockhopper Penguin, ignoring that the other results contain no such information.
errors.description: The system incorrectly inferred the answer from an irrelevant search result, assuming the presence of the bird species without proper verification.
